announcements.headline: FURTHER MINERALISATION INTERSECTED BELOW SEGILOLA
announcements.insight: This announcement confirms the extension of known mineralisation at Segilola, a key step in resource definition for Africa's largest hard-rock primary greenstone gold deposit, but lacks immediate commercial impact without updated JORC/NI 43-101 reserves or production timelines.
